get.description: Returns the full booking projection. The caller must be the booking owner, the provider of the tour, or hold the AdminBookingDashboard.Read permission. Other authenticated callers receive 403 TourBooking.OwnerMismatch.

get.summary: List the caller's tour bookings (cursor paginated).
get.description: Returns bookings owned by the authenticated user, ordered by CreatedAt DESC. Supports filters by status (comma-separated), slot-date range, and tourId. Pagination via opaque cursor (B-R10). Page size clamps to [1, 50] (default 20).

get.summary: Provider: list bookings for tours owned by the caller's provider (cursor paginated).
get.description: Owner-scoped. Resolves the caller's provider via ProviderSnapshot.OwnerUserId and returns ONLY bookings for that provider (empty page if the caller owns no provider). Supports status (comma-separated), slot-date range, and tourId filters. Each row includes the slot date/time. Requires TourBooking.ReadOwn.

get.summary: Admin: list ALL bookings across all users and providers.
get.description: Admin dashboard endpoint. Returns every booking matching the optional filters (status, slot-date range, userId, providerId, tourId, paymentStatus). Cursor paginated, same shape as /my-bookings (B-R10). Requires the AdminBookingDashboard.Read permission. paymentStatus is accepted as a hint but is currently a no-op until the Finance cross-module payment projection ships.

post.summary: Provider confirms a booking that is in AwaitingPayment or PendingConfirmation state.
post.description: Body is empty. Caller must be the provider of the tour, or an admin. Transitions the booking to Confirmed and raises a TourBookingConfirmedDomainEvent (integration event published via outbox).

post.summary: Provider rejects a PendingConfirmation booking. ALWAYS triggers a 100% automatic refund.
post.description: Reason required (10-500 chars). Caller must be the provider of the tour or admin. Booking transitions to Rejected; downstream consumers handle the refund via outbox.

post.summary: Cancel a booking (user, provider, or admin).
post.description: User cancellations follow the booking's refund-policy snapshot. Provider/admin cancellations ALWAYS produce a 100% refund and require a reason >= 10 chars. Source is auto-detected from the caller's identity and permissions.

post.summary: Provider marks a Confirmed booking as Completed after the tour has started.
post.description: Body is empty. Caller must be the provider of the tour or an admin. Returns 422 TourBooking.NotYetStarted if invoked before the slot's start time.

post.summary: Booking owner opens a dispute on a Completed booking.
post.description: Reason required (10-2000 chars). Caller must be the booking owner. Booking must be Completed within the past 48 hours. Transitions the booking to Disputed and emits booking.tour-booking.disputed.v1.

post.summary: Admin resolves a Disputed booking with resolution notes.
post.description: ResolutionNotes required (10-2000 chars). Admin-only (BookingDispute.Resolve permission). Booking must be in Disputed status. Transitions the booking to Resolved and emits booking.tour-booking.dispute-resolved.v1.

post.summary: Admin: issue a moderation warning to a user
Admin: issue a moderation ban to a user

delete.summary: Admin: lift an active moderation ban for a user

post.summary: Submit a report
post.description: Reports an entity (Review, Tour, Place, Business, or Blog) for moderation.

get.summary: Admin: list reports
get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of all submitted reports (admin-only).

post.summary: Admin: resolve a report
post.description: Resolves an open report and optionally takes action on the underlying entity.

post.summary: Create a new review (S-R1/S-R2/S-R4)
post.description: Creates a review. Profanity → AwaitingModeration. One review per target.

get.summary: Public: list reviews for an entity

put.summary: Edit review within 48-hour window (S-R3)

delete.summary: Delete a review (author or admin)

post.summary: Provider adds a reply to a review

put.summary: Update an existing reply (S-R3: no time limit for replies)

delete.summary: Delete a reply (provider own or admin)

get.summary: Get caller's reviews (paginated)
Public: list approved reviews for an entity
Public: get rating summary for an entity

post.summary: Mark a review as helpful

delete.summary: Remove helpful vote from a review

get.summary: Admin: get flagged/awaiting-moderation reviews (S-R4/S-R5)

post.summary: Report a review
post.description: Shorthand to report a specific review for moderation.

post.summary: Admin: approve a review
post.description: Restores a flagged or auto-hidden review to Published status.

post.summary: Admin: remove a review
post.description: Admin permanently removes (status=RemovedByAdmin) a review and logs the action.
